warnings.message: Multi-threaded throughput reached only 48% of 8x the single-thread result. Expected on SMT and on shared-vCPU plans; unexpected on dedicated cores.
`ttfb.mean` varied by 53% between repetitions (bound 30%). The internet is shared; this usually means congestion on the path rather than a fault in the machine.
The run reached its 512 MiB transfer ceiling, so some measurements were cut short. The ceiling is a hard bound on what this suite will pull from a third party.
`connections.plaintext` varied by 26% across repetitions, above this module's 20% bound. On a loopback HTTP measurement that usually means the machine was doing something else at the same time.
